title: Hack For Good
description: Join the biggest online coding festival of the year and showcase your skills.

prizes.name: Best Innovation
prizes.description: Awarded to the team with the most innovative project, showcasing creativity and unique problem-solving approaches.

prizes.name: Best Design
prizes.description: Given to the team that demonstrates exceptional user interface and user experience design in their project.

prizes.name: Top Performer
prizes.description: Presented to the team with the most efficient and high-performance solution.

prizes.name: Community Choice
prizes.description: Selected by the audience, this award goes to the most popular project as voted by participants and viewers.

prizes.name: Best Use of Technology
prizes.description: Awarded for the most effective and innovative use of cutting-edge technology in the project.
